parapet_entrance.name: Parapet Entrance
parapet_entrance.description: You are at the entrance to the parapet, a narrow strip of stone that stretches over a deadly drop, wind clawing at you from all sides. One wrong step and the canyon below will claim you.

items.name: Left Rider Boot
items.description: A rider boot, with dark leather, sturdy with grip on the bottom.

parapet1.name: Parapet
parapet1.description: You are on the parapet, a narrow strip of stone that stretches over a deadly drop, wind clawing at you from all sides. One wrong step and the canyon below will claim you.

parapet2.name: Parapet
parapet2.description:
You are on the parapet, a narrow strip of stone that stretches over a deadly drop, wind clawing at you from all sides. One wrong step and the canyon below will claim you.
The parapet leads to an opening in the eight-foot wall of the Rider's Quadrant in the distance.

parapet3.name: Parapet
parapet3.description:
You are on the parapet, a narrow strip of stone that stretches over a deadly drop, wind clawing at you from all sides. One wrong step and the canyon below will claim you.
The eight-foot wall of the Rider's Quadrant looms ahead of you, and the opening for the parapet is close now.

parapet4.name: Parapet
parapet4.description: You are on the stretch of the parapet within the walls of the Rider's Quadrant. The exit to the courtyard is within reach.

fourth_wing.name: Courtyard
fourth_wing.description: You stand amoung the Fourth Wing formation. The stone beneath your boots is cracked, and a couple riders linger in small groups, their eyes sharp, and their hands near their weapons.

third_wing.name: Courtyard
third_wing.description: You stand among the Third Wing formation. The noise is quieter, and controlled, with riders practicing drills and maneuvers.

second_wing.name: Courtyard
second_wing.description: You step into the Second Wing formation. This space is humming with activity, laughter and arguments in the air.

first_wing.name: Courtyard
first_wing.description: You stand among the First Wing formation. There is intentional quiet, with riders having conversations in low tones.

dorm_stairwell.name: Dorm Stairwell
dorm_stairwell.description: You are in a narrow dorm stairwell. The stone steps curve tightly upward, and the light is dim. Every sound-your breathing, your movement- echoes throughout the chamber.

items.name: A Small Lantern
items.description: A glowing ember burns in the center of the lantern, casting a warm light around it.

dragon_rotunda.name: Dragon Rotunda
dragon_rotunda.description: You stand in middle of the chamber, which stretches high above you, its walls marked with shadows and scars. The air is warm, heavy, and even in the stillness, the space feels alive.

items.name: A Pair of Riding Gloves
items.description: A pair of sturdy riding gloves, worn smooth by use.

turret.name: Turret staircase
turret.description: You are the top of a stone turret, with the entire college spread out below you, distance and small. Wind pulls at your clothes, sharp and unrelenting.

items.name: Book of Riders
items.description: roll-keeper's Book of Riders where bonds between dragon and rider are recorded.

threshing_grounds1.name: Threshing Grounds
threshing_grounds1.description: You step into a wide, open stretch of worn earth where the wind sweeps freely across the fields. The ground is dry and cracked from constant use, and the faint scent of hay lingers in the air. To the north, the land rises toward the flight field, while the path continues south deeper into the threshing grounds.

threshing_grounds2.name: Threshing Grounds
threshing_grounds2.description: The terrain here is uneven, marked by wagon ruts and scattered straw. The quiet feels heavier, as if fewer people pass through this section. Paths branch out in multiple directions, each leading deeper into the sprawling grounds.

threshing_grounds3.name: Threshing Grounds
threshing_grounds3.description: A cluster of tall, weathered trees rises here, their branches creaking softly in the wind. The shade they cast cools the ground beneath your feet, and fallen leaves crunch as you move. The area feels slightly more alive, as birds occasionally dart between the branches.

threshing_grounds4.name: Threshing Grounds
threshing_grounds4.description: The trees grow thicker here, their branches twisting together overhead. As you look more closely, something catches your eye—a small paper tucked within the crook of a branch.

trees.name: Trees
trees.description: As you pull yourself up into the branches, you find yourself surrounded by a canopy of leaves. The paper you found is now within reach, and as you unfold it, you see a riddle written in shifting symbols.

items.name: A tattered scroll
items.description:
A tattered scroll, its surface filled with ancient symbols. You stare closely, and the symbols seem to shift and rearrange themselves: 

"I am built, not born. 
 I connect two as one. 
 Break me and all is lost. 
 What am I?"

threshing_grounds5.name: Threshing Grounds
threshing_grounds5.description: This part of the grounds is quieter, with flattened grass and scattered debris hinting at past activity.

threshing_grounds6.name: Threshing Grounds
threshing_grounds6.description: A large pile of chopped wood sits here, stacked unevenly as if abandoned mid-task.

threshing_grounds7.name: Threshing Grounds
threshing_grounds7.description: The ground here is smoother, as if frequently traveled.

threshing_grounds8.name: Threshing Grounds
threshing_grounds8.description:
The air grows heavy and warm as you enter this area. Before you, dragons rest and shift, their scales glinting in the light. Some watch you closely, their eyes sharp and intelligent.

 {{DRAGON}} 

You feel a choice forming:
- run away 
- stand ground 
- approach 
- use scroll 

Every movement matters here—these creatures are powerful, and your actions will decide your fate.

threshing_grounds9.name: Threshing Grounds
threshing_grounds9.description: This area feels more secluded, with the surrounding paths partially hidden by uneven terrain.

threshing_grounds10.name: Threshing Grounds
threshing_grounds10.description: A narrow stretch of land connects different parts of the grounds.

threshing_grounds11.name: Threshing Grounds
threshing_grounds11.description: This quieter corner of the grounds feels slightly safer, though still isolated.

items.name: Combat Dagger
items.description: The everyday blade a rider carries. These daggers are used in sparring challenges and various survival situations.

items.name: Poison Dagger
items.description: Standard blade coated in poision. It is a valuable and dangerous asset in sparring challenges.

battle_brief.name: Battle Brief
battle_brief.description: A pair of sturdy riding gloves, worn smooth by use.

items.name: Map
items.description: You found a paper map of Basgiath College. It will help you with navigation.

healer_quadrant.name: Healer Quadrant
healer_quadrant.description: The air smells sharply of herbs and clean linen, with cots lining the room.

items.name: A Leigheas Serum
items.description: A bitter, amber-coloured, medicinal tonic, used to dull pain and treat injuries.

bell_tower.name: Bell Tower
bell_tower.description: You stand within a narrow and vertical space, with a massive bell hanging above.

admin_building.name: Admin Building
admin_building.description: You enter the administration building, with smooth stone walls and a heavy silence in the air.

general_office.name: General Sorrengail's Office
general_office.description: You stand in General Sorrengail's office, a precise and controlled space.

infantry_quadrant.name: Infantry Quadrant
infantry_quadrant.description: You are in the infantry quadrant, where the steady rhythm of drills and weight of steel empahsizes the physicality of the riders' training.

scribe_quadrant.name: Scribe Quadrant
scribe_quadrant.description: You stand at the entrance to the scribe quadrant, where the noise of the college fades into the quiet, studious atmosphere.

ravine_tunnel1.name: Ravine Tunnel
ravine_tunnel1.description: You stand in the narrow tunnel crossing the ravine, where damp stone walls close in, a distant rush of wind echoing through the space.

ravine_tunnel2.name: Ravine Tunnel
ravine_tunnel2.description: You stand in the narrow tunnel crossing the ravine, where damp stone walls close in, a distant rush of wind echoing through the space.

ravine_tunnel3.name: Ravine Tunnel
ravine_tunnel3.description: You stand in the narrow tunnel crossing the ravine, where damp stone walls close in, a distant rush of wind echoing through the space.

dorms.name: Dormitories
dorms.description: You are in the riders' dormitories, where narrow rows of beds, scattered belongings, and exhausted voices fill the air.

library.name: Library
library.description: You are in the library, a quiet space filled with books and the soft rustle of turning pages.

commons.name: Commons
commons.description: You are in the commons, a bustling area where students gather to socialize and study.

gathering_hall.name: Gathering Hall
gathering_hall.description: You are in the gathering hall, a large room where students come to relax and interact.

weapon_tactics.name: Weapon Tactics Classroom
weapon_tactics.description: You are in the weapon tactics classroom, a space where students learn the art of wielding their weapons effectively.

history_classroom.name: History Classroom
history_classroom.description: You are in the history classroom, a space where students learn about the past and its impact on the present.
